title: Skeggy's Axe House

services.name: Axe Throwing
services.desc: Since 2019, Skeggy’s has been Easton’s go-to spot for axe throwing, and we're keeping that tradition going inside The Sakade. Whether you've never picked up an axe before or you're already calling yourself a pro, our instructors keep things fun, approachable, and just competitive enough to bring out your inner lumberjack. With 9 axe-throwing lanes, there's plenty of room to bring your friends, settle a few rivalries, celebrate a birthday, or just try something completely different. And because Skeggy’s is now part of The Sakade, your night doesn't have to end when the axes are put away. Grab a drink, check out the arcade, grab some food, and keep the good times

blurb: Experience a night of fun and games in the heart of Easton, PA! Whether you're itching to hurl some hatchets, dive into arcade madness, or just lounge with your pals while munching on our mouthwatering grub and sipping drinks, we've got it
